To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

DCFT methods are reliable and accurate for the description of equilibrium geometries, thermochemistry and kinetics, and that ODC-12 represents the most reliable and most accurate density cumulant functional formulation to date.

ODC-12, a new density cumulant functional, outperforms all other density functional approximations and coupled-electron pair theories in this study and is comparable to CCSD(T) for the thermochemistry of closed-shell systems.
ODC-12 performs as well as or better than OCEPA and CCSD for the thermochemistry and kinetics benchmark tests.

the benchmarking of density cumulant functionals, which are based on a new class of density cumulant approximations.
the development and implementation of a new density functional approximation to the electron correlation energy based on a cumulant expansion of the density operator.
the development, implementation, and benchmarking of DCFT.
